rulings.issue: Should shared components / shared objects be marked as cross-domain in single-domain views?
rulings.decision: No cross-domain marking while domains are modeled one by one; decide uniformly after all business domains are modeled (criteria: repeated in >= 2 L1s or business lines + same business object + rules can be standardized)

rulings.by: B3 layout rework (six rounds on the reference domain)
rulings.issue: Arrows in value-stream diagrams are hard to read and the links look messy
rulings.decision: One connector per link, exclusive ports, last segment >= 0.06"; the hard thresholds of check_links are the acceptance criterion
